name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship – Technical Diploma
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
summary: A national scholarship for girl students admitted to the first year of an AICTE-approved diploma or directly to the second year through lateral entry.
benefits: ₹50,000 per year under the 2026–27 scheme listing and current AICTE scheme guidance; confirm exact permitted use and conditions in the linked diploma guideline.

eligibility.admission: First-year diploma or second-year lateral entry
eligibility.familyLimit: Maximum two girls per family; current scheme conditions apply.

applicationProcess: Apply through NSP during the notified AICTE scholarship cycle.
statusNote: NSP lists the 2026–27 student application window through 30 November 2026. Verification dates are later; confirm the current scheme notice and your institution's eligibility.

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship – Technical Diploma
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
summary: Support for specially-abled students admitted to the first year of an AICTE-approved diploma or the second year through lateral entry.
benefits: ₹50,000 per year under the 2026–27 scheme listing and current AICTE scheme guidance; confirm exact permitted use and conditions in the linked diploma guideline.

eligibility.admission: First-year diploma or second-year lateral entry

applicationProcess: Apply through NSP when the AICTE diploma scheme is open.
statusNote: NSP lists the 2026–27 student application window through 30 November 2026. Verification dates are later; confirm the current scheme notice and your institution's eligibility.

name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship – Technical Diploma
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
summary: Support for eligible students in AICTE-approved technical diploma courses who meet the scheme's specified family circumstances, including eligible orphans, wards of parents who died due to COVID-19, or wards of armed forces/CAPF personnel martyred in action, as defined by current rules.
benefits: ₹50,000 per year as a lump-sum scholarship for eligible technical diploma students, under the published AICTE Swanath guidelines.

eligibility.beneficiaryCategories: Orphan students and other categories defined in current Swanath guidelines; verify the complete current list with AICTE.
eligibility.applicant: Eligible circumstances include orphanhood, parent(s) deceased due to COVID-19, wards of Armed Forces/CAPF personnel martyred in action, and additional circumstances as specified in the current AICTE guideline.
eligibility.income: Annual family income must not exceed ₹8 lakh under the published guideline.

requiredDocuments: Income and identity documents as requested
applicationProcess: Apply through NSP during the notified cycle.
statusNote: NSP lists the 2026–27 student application window through 30 November 2026. Verification dates are later; confirm the current scheme notice and your institution's eligibility.

name: HDFC Bank Parivartan ECSS – Diploma Students
summary: Financial support for diploma, ITI and polytechnic students facing financial difficulty or a personal/family crisis. Diploma applicants must be pursuing a diploma after Class 12.
benefits: ₹18,000 for eligible Diploma, ITI and Polytechnic students in the 2026–27 programme.

eligibility.course: Diploma after Class 12; ITI and polytechnic courses are also covered.
eligibility.preference: Preference for applicants facing personal or family crisis in the previous three years.

applicationProcess: Apply through the official ECSS programme page when applications are open.
statusNote: NSP lists the 2026–27 student application window through 30 November 2026. Verification dates are later; confirm the current scheme notice and your institution's eligibility.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities – Diploma
provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of India
summary: Central post-matric support for eligible students with benchmark disabilities enrolled in recognised diploma programmes. Course, disability, income and other-scholarship conditions apply.
benefits: The department lists tuition/admission support, maintenance allowance and book/disability allowances. Check the latest guidelines for applicable amounts and fee ceiling.

eligibility.course: Recognised diploma course; confirm course group and duration in current guidelines.

requiredDocuments: Bank and identity details requested by NSP
applicationProcess: Check the current scheme guidelines and apply through the National Scholarship Portal when the application window is open.
statusNote: NSP lists the 2026–27 student application window through 30 November 2026. Verification dates are later; confirm the current scheme notice and your institution's eligibility.

name: Telangana ePASS – Post-Matric Scholarship (Polytechnic / Diploma)
scholarshipType: Post-matric fee reimbursement and maintenance support
summary: Telangana ePASS post-matric support includes eligible Polytechnic courses (listed in Group II) for students covered by state welfare categories. Institution recognition, course, income, admission and attendance rules apply.
benefits: Eligible students may receive reimbursement of eligible tuition fees and monthly maintenance/mess support. Polytechnic is listed under Group II; the official rate table distinguishes college-attached hostel and day-scholar rates.

eligibility.course: Eligible Polytechnic / diploma course at a recognised institution; check the official course and college lists.
eligibility.income: Different category-wise annual family-income ceilings apply.
eligibility.attendance: Renewal requires prescribed attendance and promotion conditions.

applicationProcess: Use Telangana ePASS Post-Matric fresh or renewal registration for academic year 2026–27. Follow the current biometric / verification instructions and confirm your category's eligibility.
statusNote: NSP lists the 2026–27 student application window through 30 November 2026. Verification dates are later; confirm the current scheme notice and your institution's eligibility.
